sourceExecution: The Web exporter bundles the full JavaScript Lab Game v2 runtime. The profile describes its host boundary; it does not replace or narrow the Lab Game v2 core.

javaFollowOn.reason: Orbit QuickJS/LRP does not execute Java Lab TeaVM modules. A representative current TeaVM output imports teavmJso, teavmMath, teavm, and wasm:js-string host functions; packaging .wasm alone is insufficient.
gates: profile actual TeaVM imports/exports and compiler version
select a Rust WebAssembly runtime that satisfies that ABI and device budgets
implement and version input, frame, render, audio, lifecycle, and error bridges
pass paired desktop traces before device qualification

capabilities.gameplayRuntime: The bundled JavaScript engine runs Game Lab v2 scenes, components and JavaScript physics inside the package; this is separate from Orbit's native ECS and Rapier adapter.

metadataOperations.tilemap: The bundled Lab runtime expands each visible tile into an ordered sprite command. The adapter ignores the preceding tilemap metadata marker and draws those sprite commands.

capabilities.input: Logical keyboard/gamepad aliases are forwarded as keydown/keyup; Game Lab derives held/pressed/released edges. Pointer and mouse events are unavailable.
capabilities.audio: Notes and songs are mapped to Orbit synthesis; songs support at most four tracks and are not sample-identical to WebAudio.

frameTime.hostBehavior: Orbit clamps finite dt to [0, 0.1] before calling the game; non-finite dt becomes 0.1.
frameTime.exporterBehavior: The Web Lab adapter rejects non-finite dt and values outside [0, 0.1].
frameTime.requirement: Lab v2 receives finite dt in [0, 0.1] seconds.

drawing.rect: GameLab center x/y to LRP top-left x-width/2,y-height/2
drawing.sprite: center x/y to LRP top-left x-width/2,y-height/2; radians converted to degrees for drawSpriteEx
drawing.rotation: radians in Lab v2; adapter converts where the host operation requires degrees
drawing.text: alignment and baseline approximated from host measureText; pixel-identical font rendering is not guaranteed

input.edges: Host level changes are translated to keydown/keyup; Lab derives held/pressed/released state.
limitations: No pointer or mouse event mapping in this adapter.

audio.note: Lab note names convert to frequency; beats convert to milliseconds using BPM.
audio.song: At most four tracks; host clamps BPM to 60..300 and may pad loop tracks to a common duration. This is not sample-identical to WebAudio.

failClosed: missing texture/asset required by a render command
